verdict.rationale: n8n is a workflow automation platform, not itself a coding agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. Its docs list a first-party MCP Server Trigger node, and a probe confirms an official MCP server is documented there. That is a direct capability, but the evidence is only a page title with no detail on how an external agent connects, authenticates, or which tools are exposed. The MCP Client node is client-side and is not credited. Missing for 10: documented connection and auth steps for external agents, scope of the exposed tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
